purpose: Transparent cutout of the selected green message-bubble mascot for ChatSeek

Preserve the exact selected mascot: soft pale pistachio-green matte mochi body, wide flattened rounded message-box silhouette with gently dipped top, small integrated tail at LOWER RIGHT, two small glossy BLACK eyes, tiny black smile, original proportions, lighting and pleasant texture. Do not redesign, do not make it a round sphere, do not add white eyes, limbs, props, text or frame. Keep the complete original character including its tail and soft edge. Return a FACELESS green message-bubble body on a truly transparent background. Preserve the exact existing silhouette, dimensions/aspect ratio, full green body, curved lower-right tail, matte grain texture, lighting and original framing, scale and position.
